# QYL0112: Span work names and business keys are compile-time constants

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/Qyl.Telemetry.SemanticConventions.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| Property | Value |
| -- | -- |
| Severity | Error |
| Category | `OpenTelemetry` |
| Code fix | No |
| Analyzer | `Qyl0112NonConstantTelemetryNameAnalyzer` |
| Enabled by default | Yes |

## Description

A Spans.Work name is the operation's identity in failure signatures and a SetAppTag key is a stored column, so both must stay low-cardinality. Use a constant and put the varying part into a SetAppTag value.
